description: Cost decoration owned by a service and consumed by `graphql-limit-count`. Managed as a separate subresource, not an inline service field.

service_id.description: ID of the owning service, set from the URL. Omit when creating or replacing; cannot be patched.

field_path.description: Position in the GraphQL schema. A type name weights fields returning that type; a type and field name weights that field; further segments restrict the selection chain. `Query` or `Mutation` alone weights the whole operation.

add_arguments.description: Arguments whose values are added to `add_value`.

mul_value.description: Multiplier applied to the cost of selected children.

mul_arguments.description: Arguments whose values multiply `mul_value`. Under `node_quantifier`, these quantifiers carry to deeper quantified nodes.
